title: The company with 12 employees and one client
description: A family office is a company built to manage one family's money and nothing else. It only starts to make sense above a hundred million dollars, and it costs about one percent of the fortune every year just to run.

scenes.narration: This company has twelve employees and exactly one client.
scenes.imagePrompt: A bright glass-walled boardroom high in a private bank tower, a cheerful group of well-dressed executives in warm mid-conversation around a polished table set beside floor-to-ceiling windows, golden daylight streaming across the table, a sprawling sunlit city skyline outside the glass with the open sea visible on the distant horizon, hand-stitched leather chairs, a dark coffered ceiling and shadowed upper wall filling the entire top third of the frame, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: It is called a family office, and it exists to run one fortune like a business.
scenes.imagePrompt: Corner office of a single-family office atop a private bank tower in bright midday sunlight, a warm honey-toned wood partner's desk with rich saturated color, a polished brass banker's lamp and a leather folder, floor-to-ceiling windows with a crisp, sharply detailed sunlit city skyline stretching to the horizon, warm golden light filling the room, everything in crisp sharp focus from front to back

scenes.narration: Below about a hundred million dollars in assets, building one does not make sense.
scenes.imagePrompt: Heavy hand-polished brass and gold vault door standing open in the sunlit stone corridor of a private bank, rich warm gold and amber tones glowing off the polished metal, a deep blue sky glimpsed through a high arched window filling the top of the frame in shadow, a warm terracotta stone floor filling the entire bottom edge of the frame, vivid saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: Running it costs roughly one percent of the money, every year.
scenes.imagePrompt: A bright modern open-plan office of a single-family office, colorful contemporary furniture in warm jewel tones, a small group of visibly happy staff smiling and collaborating around a sleek glass table with laptops and folders, floor-to-ceiling windows flooding the room with daylight, vivid saturated color, a dark modern ceiling with recessed lighting filling the top third of the frame in shadow, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: So the office burns a million dollars a year before it earns anything.
scenes.imagePrompt: A vivid, colorful open-plan floor of a single-family office, many well-dressed staff working at bright modern desks among warm jewel-toned furnishings and tall potted palms, floor-to-ceiling windows flooding the space with golden daylight and a distant sunlit skyline, a dark modern ceiling with track lighting filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: The staff are not salespeople. Nobody in the building is trying to sell the family a product.
scenes.imagePrompt: Reception area of a single-family office in warm bright daylight, a polished rose-gold marble counter with a single brass bell, two rich cognac-leather armchairs beside a low table with fresh flowers, a tall window throwing a vivid wedge of golden light across a book-matched marble floor with warm veining, a dark panelled wall filling the top of the frame in shadow, vivid saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus

scenes.narration: That is what the fee actually buys: advice with nothing standing behind it.
scenes.imagePrompt: Two rich cognac-leather armchairs facing each other across a low dark stone table with a bronze inlay, in the sunlit private study of a single-family office, floor-to-ceiling bookshelves glowing warm amber in soft shadow behind them, hard golden daylight entering from a side window and washing across the floor, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus

scenes.narration: So: twelve people, one client, and a payroll that only starts to make sense above nine figures.
scenes.imagePrompt: A bright glass-walled boardroom high in a private bank tower, seen from the head of a polished table where a cheerful group of well-dressed executives sit in warm conversation beside floor-to-ceiling windows, golden daylight streaming across the table, a sunlit city skyline outside the glass with the open sea visible on the distant horizon, hand-stitched leather chairs receding down both sides, a dark coffered ceiling filling the top of the frame in shadow, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field
